title: WooCommerce COD Fraud Protection — EscaraPay Integration Se Fake Orders Band Karo
excerpt: WooCommerce store pe COD fraud aur fake orders se pareshan hain? EscaraPay ka webhook integration setup karo — har COD order pe automatic token collect hoga, genuine buyers verify honge aur RTO loss khatam hoga.
metaDescription: WooCommerce COD fraud protection guide — EscaraPay integration se fake orders band karo, RTO loss rokein aur genuine buyers verify karein. Step-by-step WooCommerce webhook setup guide India 2026.

content.text: WooCommerce India ka sabse popular ecommerce platform hai — lakhs of WordPress websites isko use karti hain. Lekin COD fraud ek aisi problem hai jo har WooCommerce seller ko affect karti hai. Is guide mein EscaraPay integration se ye problem solve karne ka poora tarika samjhenge.
WooCommerce COD Fraud Kitna Bada Problem Hai?

India mein abhi bhi 60% ecommerce orders COD mein hote hain. WooCommerce sellers ke liye ye ek double-edged sword hai — COD milne se conversions badhti hain, lekin fraud aur RTO bhi badhta hai. Industry data ke hisaab se D2C brands mein COD RTO rate 20-40% tak hoti hai. Matlab har 5 mein se 1-2 orders wapas aata hai.

items.title: Prank/Spam Orders
items.desc: Koi bhi kisi ke naam se order kar sakta hai COD mein — koi verification nahi hoti. Spam bots bhi fake orders generate karte hain WooCommerce stores pe.

items.title: Address Fraud
items.desc: Buyers galat ya incomplete address dete hain. Delivery attempt fail hoti hai, courier wapas laata hai, double shipping charge aata hai.

items.title: COD Refusal
items.desc: Delivery ke time buyer door pe aa ke bolta hai 'nahi lena' ya phone nahi uthata. Product gaya, shipping gayi, time gaya.

items.title: Competitor Attacks
items.desc: Competitors sometimes bulk fake orders daalte hain tumhara inventory lock karne ya operations disrupt karne ke liye — COD mein ye easy hai.

content.text: EscaraPay Ka Solution — Token Before Dispatch

EscaraPay ek simple but effective solution provide karta hai: jab WooCommerce pe COD order aaye, buyer ko automatically order value ka 10% token amount pay karna padta hai — before you dispatch. Ye token ek genuine intent signal hai. Sirf serious buyers token pay karte hain.
💡 Token = Commitment. ₹1,500 ke order pe sirf ₹150 token. Ye itna reasonable hai ki genuine buyer instantly pay karta hai. Fraud buyer? Woh token page se bounce kar jaata hai. Problem solved!

items.title: Method 1 — WooCommerce Native Webhook (Technical)
items.desc: WordPress Admin → WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → Webhooks → Add Webhook → Topic: Order Created → Delivery URL: EscaraPay Integration tab se copy karo → Secret: blank → Save. Phir WP Webhooks Pro plugin se x-api-key header add karo.

items.title: Method 2 — Zapier/Make Integration (No-Code, Recommended)
items.desc: Zapier pe account banao → Trigger: WooCommerce New Order → Filter: payment_method = cod → Action: Webhooks by Zapier → POST to EscaraPay URL → Fields map karo (buyer_name, email, phone, product_name, order_amount) → Activate. Iska monthly plan ~₹1,500 hai.

items.title: Method 3 — Trust Badge Only (Free, Immediate)
items.desc: WordPress → Appearance → Theme Editor → footer.php → </body> se pehle paste karo: <script src='https://escarapay.in/sdk/escara.js' data-seller-id='TUMHARA_ID'></script>. Ye buyer ko trust badge dikhata hai. Manual orders EscaraPay dashboard se create karo.

content.text: Zapier method sabse easy hai bina coding ke. Niche detailed steps hain:

items.title: Step 1 — EscaraPay Setup
items.desc: escarapay.in → Register as Seller → Integration tab → API Key generate karo → Copy kar lo.

items.title: Step 2 — Zapier Account
items.desc: zapier.com → Sign up (free trial available) → Create Zap.

items.title: Step 3 — WooCommerce Trigger
items.desc: Trigger app: WooCommerce → Event: New Order → WooCommerce store connect karo → Test trigger.

items.title: Step 4 — COD Filter
items.desc: Filter step add karo → payment_method Contains 'cod' OR 'cash' → Only COD orders aage jayenge.

items.title: Step 5 — EscaraPay Webhook Action
items.desc: Action: Webhooks by Zapier → POST → URL: https://escarapay-backend.onrender.com/api/integrations/order → Headers: x-api-key = tumhari API key → Data: buyer_name, buyer_email, buyer_phone, product_name, order_amount, platform_order_id map karo → Test → Activate.

content.text: Zapier ya Make mein ye fields map karne honge:

items.title: buyer_name
items.desc: WooCommerce: billing.first_name + billing.last_name

items.title: buyer_email
items.desc: WooCommerce: billing.email

items.title: buyer_phone
items.desc: WooCommerce: billing.phone (last 10 digits use karo)

items.title: product_name
items.desc: WooCommerce: line_items[0].name (first product ka naam)

items.title: order_amount
items.desc: WooCommerce: total

items.title: platform_order_id
items.desc: WooCommerce: id (WooCommerce Order ID for reference)

items: Customer WooCommerce pe COD order place karta hai
Zapier/Webhook automatically EscaraPay ko order data bhejta hai
EscaraPay buyer ke email pe token payment link bhejta hai
Order tumhare EscaraPay dashboard mein 'Pending Token' dikhta hai
Buyer token pay karta hai — status 'Token Paid' ho jaata hai
EscaraPay buyer ko delivery confirmation link bhejta hai
Buyer confirm karta hai → payment tumhare UPI pe release hota hai
14 din mein buyer ne kuch na kiya → auto-release tumhare liye

content.text: Future mein EscaraPay ek dedicated WooCommerce plugin release kar rahi hai jo automatic integration provide karegi bina Zapier ke. Abhi ke liye webhook ya Zapier method use karo — ye equally effective hai.

items.title: Kya Prepaid WooCommerce orders bhi affect honge?
items.desc: Nahi! EscaraPay sirf COD orders detect karta hai. Razorpay, PayU, Cashfree se aaye prepaid orders automatically skip ho jaate hain. Filter step add karna zaroori hai Zapier mein.

items.title: Agar buyer token pay na kare toh kya hoga?
items.desc: Order 'Pending Token' status mein rahega. Aap WooCommerce order hold pe dal do aur EscaraPay admin se buyer ko WhatsApp karo. 10 din baad automatic reminder jayega. 14 din baad order cancel.

items.title: EscaraPay ka commission kitna hai?
items.desc: 5% of token amount. ₹1,000 order pe ₹100 token. EscaraPay ka commission = ₹5 sirf. Baaki ₹95 tumhare (minus gateway fee). Very fair deal.

items.title: Kya multiple products ke orders handle hote hain?
items.desc: Haan! Multiple line items ko comma-separated product name mein convert kiya jaata hai. Full order amount pe token calculate hota hai.

content.text: WooCommerce aur EscaraPay ka combination India ke online sellers ke liye game-changer hai. COD ka benefit rakho — genuine buyers ke liye easy checkout, fake buyers automatically filter. Aaj setup karo aur pehle hafte se fark dekho. Free account banao escarapay.in pe!
